instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of each adjective.

hint.text:
If an adjective ends with a y, you have to change the y to an i before adding the ending -er or -est.

For example:
pretty → prettier → prettiest
hint.sound:
If an adjective ends with a why, you have to change the why, to an eye, before adding the ending -e r, or -e s t.

For example:
pretty becomes prettier, which becomes prettiest

atoms.b: Some adjectives do not form their comparatives and superlatives by adding -er and -est. Instead, some use the words ((++more many)) and ((++most all)) to build these forms.
atoms.sound: ssml: some adjectives do not form their comparatives and superlatives by adding. e r and e s t. Instead, some use the words more and most to build these forms.

atoms.b: Your new dining chairs are ((more_comfortable)) than the old ones.
My mother is ((more_understanding)) than I give her credit for.
This is the ((most_thoughtful)) gift I’ve ever received.
My geography teacher is the ((most_uptight)) person I know.
Our ((newest)) school play might be our ((most_ambitious)) project to date.
